## Held Names That Reported This Week
- **$PLTR (Palantir Technologies):** Reported Q2 2026 earnings after market close on Monday, August 3, 2026. Posted an EPS of $0.41, beating analyst estimates of $0.33 by 24.24%. Revenue rose 92.8% year-over-year to $1.94 billion, surpassing estimates of $1.81 billion. The company also raised its FY 2026 revenue guidance to 82% year-over-year growth, with US commercial revenue guidance increasing to 134% year-over-year.
- **$SHOP (Shopify):** Released Q2 2026 earnings before market open on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. Reported an EPS of $0.42, beating the consensus estimate of $0.40. Revenue rose 33.7% year-over-year to $3.58 billion, exceeding analyst estimates. AI-driven merchant and channel growth were highlighted, prompting a higher near-term revenue outlook. Shares soared approximately 20% in response to the report.

## Major Events (Past 5 Trading Days)
- **Friday, August 7, 2026: US July Non-Farm Payrolls Report.** The report came in significantly higher than expected at 178,000 new jobs for July, compared to a consensus of 88,000, setting the tone for market sentiment into next week.
- **Monday, August 3, 2026: Palantir ($PLTR) Q2 Earnings Beat.** The strong beat on EPS and revenue, alongside raised guidance, reinforced the AI compute thesis for a core holding and likely fueled its significant rebound this week.
- **Wednesday, August 5, 2026: Shopify ($SHOP) Q2 Earnings Beat.** The e-commerce platform delivered strong results driven by AI, with its shares reacting positively, signaling strength in its sector.
- **Monday, August 3, 2026: US-Iran De-escalation.** President Trump's decision to cancel military strikes against Iran and pursue diplomatic talks led to a broad market uplift and a notable drop in crude oil prices.
- **Wednesday, August 5, 2026: $SPX500 Intraweek Drop.** The index experienced a sharp intraweek sell-off, dropping to an intraweek low of 7289.1, demonstrating underlying market volatility despite the week's net gain.

## Draft Saturday Post

Hi Everyone,

The US trading week closed on Friday, August 7, 2026, with the $SPX500 finishing up a modest +0.1% at 7480.9. This net gain, however, masked a more volatile path, particularly on Wednesday, August 5, when the index dropped sharply to an intraweek low of 7289.1 before recovering. Leading the macro events this week was Friday's July Non-Farm Payrolls report, which delivered a significant upside surprise of 178,000 new jobs, well above expectations. This strong employment data will undoubtedly shape market sentiment moving into next week.

Our portfolio saw a dynamic week, particularly within our AI compute cluster. Palantir ($PLTR) delivered a standout performance with its Q2 2026 earnings reported on Monday, August 3. The company comfortably beat both EPS and revenue estimates, and importantly, raised its full-year revenue guidance significantly. This reinforced our core AI software thesis and drove a strong recovery in the position. We also saw positive momentum from Shopify ($SHOP), which reported strong Q2 earnings on Wednesday, August 5, highlighting AI-driven growth and resulting in a notable jump in its share price.

The crypto cluster saw more measured moves. $BTC and $ETH traded in a narrow range for much of the week, with Bitcoin starting around 63,430 and ending the week around 64930.1. While our direct crypto holdings were relatively quiet, Robinhood ($HOOD) continued to benefit from its strong Q2 earnings announced just prior to this week, although Coinbase ($COIN) continued to be a challenging hold. Overall, the portfolio delivered a positive performance this week, primarily driven by the strong earnings from key AI compute names.

I continue to monitor the market's reaction to the latest jobs data and upcoming economic indicators. We remain focused on our conviction holdings in AI compute and crypto, and I will share further updates as new market drivers emerge.
